subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: Should Doctor preserve and migrate valid oversized Reef legacy state, or is an explicit fail-closed recovery workflow acceptable for those users?
rationale: The byte cap is mechanically sound, but choosing whether persistent user history is streamed, converted, quarantined, or rejected is a product and migration-contract decision that cannot be selected safely by review automation.

options.title: Preserve oversized state
options.body: Implement a bounded streaming or staged migration/recovery path so valid large audit and replay history remains recoverable without disabling Doctor.

options.title: Accept explicit fail-closed recovery
options.body: Keep the cap only if Reef owners document a supported recovery process and accept that oversized legacy state requires operator intervention.

recommendation.title: Preserve oversized state
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded streaming or staged migration/recovery path so valid large audit and replay history remains recoverable without disabling Doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main history lookup is needed to identify the Reef durable-state owner before assigning this migration-contract choice.
